title: Bitcoin, the Law of God, and the Jury
summary: The laws of the universe are fundamentally connected to the value of life. This episode explains how the great controversy between good and evil manifests in financial terms through the nature of the monies involved. Note the interplay of freedom and restrictions. This episode introduces the millennial rest and touches on AI resurrections.
